commands.command: Compare M124 and M129 strict miner artifacts from seed 9860 to isolate whether the M129 proof-surface regression is caused by visible matching, action divergence, margin-gap shrinkage, or source selection.
commands.name: m131_proof_surface_regression_diagnosis

decision_rule: Classify the proof-surface regression mode before designing another objective; do not start PPO from M129.
failure_criteria: diagnosis cannot explain why fresh selected pairs shrink
fixed-corpus loss is treated as enough for PPO
fresh selected physical pairs below the M122/M127 proof-surface thresholds are ignored
hypothesis: M129 overfits the deduplicated corpus enough to reduce fresh proof-surface diversity. A repair should explicitly retain or mine fresh outcome-surface diversity instead of optimizing only fixed snippets.
success_criteria: regression mode is localized with M124/M129 side-by-side metrics
diagnosis distinguishes action-distance changes from rollout margin-gap changes
repair path is specified without starting PPO
M62 control cleanliness remains part of the next gate
PPO readiness is still decided by gates, not objective loss alone
